challenges.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Acorai, I contribute to advancing
the machine learning capabilities of a fast-growing start-up with global
aspirations in healthcare technology. My role encompasses end-to-end

LLM Workflow for Medical Data Extraction:
Developed and implemented an automated workflow utilizing Large Language
Models, specifically GPT-4, combined with preprocessing steps and advanced
prompt engineering, to directly extract structured key information from
unstructured medical reports and clinical trial documents.
Evaluated the quality and accuracy of the extracted data by comparing model
outputs against manually reviewed documents and established reference data,
ensuring high precision and recall for the structured output.

Biomedical Signal Analysis (PPG/rPPG):
Engineered ML models to predict blood pressure non-invasively from
Photoplethysmography (PPG) and remote PPG (rPPG) signals.
Applied advanced signal preprocessing, feature extraction (time-domain,
frequency-domain, wavelet), and regression techniques to enable real-time
health monitoring insights for clients.

Data Scientist

Tunisie
At Datavora, I designed and deployed end-to-end machine learning solutions
across healthcare, e-commerce, and agriculture, driving innovation through
real-world AI applications.
In the biomedical domain, I engineered ML models to predict blood pressure
from PPG and rPPG signals, applying signal preprocessing, feature extraction,
and regression techniques to enable non-invasive, real-time health monitoring.
Separately, I developed a real-time eye movement tracking system using
computer vision and facial landmark detection to enhance user interaction in
accessibility and immersive tech.
For B2B e-commerce, I built a product matching algorithm to align inconsistent
product data across vendors. Using a hybrid pipeline of NLP and visual
similarity models, I automated catalog matching, increasing accuracy by over
30% and reducing manual effort for large-scale inventory systems.
